name: Creative Lab Kobe, CLIK (クリエイティブラボ神戸)
operator: Kobe Urban Promotion Service Co., Ltd. (神戸都市振興サービス株式会社)
address: 6-3-7 Minatojima Minamimachi, Chuo-ku, Kobe 650-0047 (神戸市中央区港島南町6-3-7)
price_raw: 賃料の目安: 施設までお問い合わせください
notes: All-wet-lab building of about 107 private rooms from roughly 38 to 100 m2, BSL2, with an animal facility run by FBRI. The KBIC portal marked it as having vacancies (空きあり); rent is by inquiry.

name: Startup Creative Lab, SCL (スタートアップ・クリエイティブラボ)
operator: Leave a Nest Co., Ltd. and Inner Resource Inc. (株式会社リバネス・株式会社Inner Resource); building managed by Kobe Urban Promotion Service Co., Ltd.
address: CLIK 2F, 6-3-7 Minatojima Minamimachi, Chuo-ku, Kobe 650-0047 (神戸市中央区港島南町6-3-7 クリエイティブラボ神戸2階)
price_raw: 月額利用料：ベンチ（シェアラボ）130,000円、デスク（シェアオフィス）30,000円 ※神戸市からの利用料補助制度あり / 敷金の目安: 無し
notes: Bench-type shared wet lab (23 benches of 1500x750 mm, max 2 per company, 260 m2 incl. BSL1 and BSL2 open labs) plus 20 desks and six 38 m2 private wet rooms, usable 24/365 with screening interview. Kobe City's share-lab subsidy can cover up to half the usage fee, capped at 1,000,000 JPY per year.

name: Kobe Medical Device Development Center, MEDDEC (神戸医療機器開発センター)
operator: Organization for Small & Medium Enterprises and Regional Innovation, JAPAN (中小機構, SMRJ)
address: 7-1-16 Minatojima Minamimachi, Chuo-ku, Kobe 650-0047 (神戸市中央区港島南町7-1-16)
price_raw: 賃料（税込）: 31.5㎡ 167,706円 / 63.0㎡ 335,412円 / 80.5㎡ 428,582円 (period not stated on page); 敷金: 税抜賃料の3か月分
notes: SMRJ incubator with all P2 wet-lab rooms plus a surgical operating room for live pig research. As of the 2026-09-29 update, rooms 205 (63 m2), 301B, 303A and 305A (31.5 m2 each) were open for applicants; screening is by documents and interview.

name: Kobe Healthcare Industry Development Center, HI-DEC (神戸健康産業開発センター)
operator: Organization for Small & Medium Enterprises and Regional Innovation, JAPAN (中小機構, SMRJ)
address: 6-7-4 Minatojima Minamimachi, Chuo-ku, Kobe 650-0047 (神戸市中央区港島南町6-7-4)
notes: SMRJ incubator for health and medical startups with all wet-lab (BSL2) rooms. As of 2026-09-29, 11 rooms from 40 to 80 m2 were listed as recruiting, which is the most open supply found in the cluster.

name: Kobe Medical Innovation Center, KCMI (神戸医療イノベーションセンター)
operator: Kobe Future City Co., Ltd. (株式会社こうべ未来都市機構)
address: 6-3-5 Minatojima Minamimachi, Chuo-ku, Kobe 650-0046 (神戸市中央区港島南町6丁目3番5)
price_raw: 賃料の目安: 施設までお問い合わせください
notes: Wet labs from about 50 m2 and CPC-grade floors, connected to Keisan Kagaku Center station; no shared equipment. Vacancy and rent are by inquiry.

name: Kobe KIMEC Center Building (神戸キメックセンタービル)
operator: Kobe Future City Co., Ltd. (株式会社こうべ未来都市機構)
address: 1-5-2 Minatojima Minamimachi, Chuo-ku, Kobe 650-0047 (神戸市中央区港島南町1丁目5番2)
price_raw: 賃料の目安: 施設までお問い合わせください
notes: Office tower with BSL1 wet labs on floors 5 to 7, from about 86 m2 per the KRP listing (the KBIC page says about 50 m2). Wet-lab tenancies have a term limit whose length is not published.

name: Kobe International Business Center, KIBC (神戸国際ビジネスセンター)
operator: Kobe Future City Co., Ltd. (株式会社こうべ未来都市機構)
address: 5-5-2 Minatojima Minamimachi, Chuo-ku, Kobe (神戸市中央区港島南町５丁目５番２号)
notes: Large multi-use building with BSL1 wet labs on floors 3 and 4 in units of at least 85 m2 (north wing) or 71 m2 (south wing), plus WAM manufacturing floors. Better suited to a larger tenant than a small residency.

name: Kobe Biomedical Creation Center, BMA (神戸バイオメディカル創造センター)
operator: Kobe Urban Promotion Service Co., Ltd. (神戸都市振興サービス株式会社)
address: 1-5-5 Minatojima Minamimachi, Chuo-ku, Kobe 650-0047 (神戸市中央区港島南町1-5-5)
price_raw: 賃料の目安: 施設までお問い合わせください
notes: All-wet-lab research wing plus a CPC wing, rooms from about 80 m2, BSL2, with an animal facility run by a separate company. The KBIC portal marked it as having vacancies (空きあり).

name: Kobe Advanced Medical Center, IBRI (先端医療センター)
operator: Foundation for Biomedical Research and Innovation at Kobe (神戸医療産業都市推進機構)
notes: A 4F wet-lab skeleton space from about 80 m2 (no ceiling, HVAC or fit-out) is offered while other floors are listed as full, and the KBIC portal marked it 空きあり. A tenant would need to fit it out, which suits a longer commitment.

name: Kobe Hybrid Business Center, KHBC (神戸ハイブリッドビジネスセンター)
operator: Foundation for Biomedical Research and Innovation at Kobe (神戸医療産業都市推進機構)
address: 6-7-6 Minatojima Minamimachi, Chuo-ku, Kobe 650-0047 (神戸市中央区港島南町6丁目7番6)
price_raw: 賃料の目安: 施設までお問い合わせください
contact_name: 経営企画部 施設管理課
notes: Small all-wet-lab rooms (about 35 to 60 m2 on 1F and 48 m2 units on 2F to 4F), plus a 24/7 shared office with one-year contracts. The KRP listing leaves BSL blank while the KBIC page states level 2.

name: Kobe Clinical Research Information Center, TRI (神戸臨床研究情報センター)
operator: Foundation for Biomedical Research and Innovation at Kobe (神戸医療産業都市推進機構)
address: 1-5-4 Minatojima Minamimachi, Chuo-ku, Kobe 650-0047 (神戸市中央区港島南町1丁目5番4号)
price_raw: 賃料の目安: 施設までお問い合わせください
contact_name: 経営企画部 施設管理課
notes: Rental labs of 23 to 165 m2 (28 rooms on 3F to 4F, two on 2F); sqft_total is the building's stated leasable area of 7,340 m2. Wet-lab capability and BSL are not stated, and tenancy is term-limited under the TRI ordinance.

name: International Medical Development Center, IMDA (国際医療開発センター)
operator: Foundation for Biomedical Research and Innovation at Kobe (神戸医療産業都市推進機構)
address: 1-6-5 Minatojima Minamimachi, Chuo-ku, Kobe 650-0047 (神戸市中央区港島南町1丁目6番5号)
price_raw: 賃料の目安: 施設までお問い合わせください
notes: About 50 small lab rooms of 20 to 80 m2 plus 20 small offices (max 3 years). The KRP listing marks BSL and shared equipment as unavailable and KBIC lists it as office, so it may suit dry or device work rather than biology.

name: International Medical Plaza, IMP (インターナショナルメディカルプラザ)
notes: Wet labs on floors 1, 2 and 4 with a surgical operating room usable for live pig experiments and surgical simulators, 3 minutes from Iryo Center station. Unit sizes, BSL, operator and rent are not published.

name: Shimin Byoin-mae Building (市民病院前ビル)
notes: Small building with BSL1 wet labs on 4F from about 60 m2 and offices on 3F, 2 minutes from Iryo Center station. Operator is not named on the portal; the facility site is on the Kobe New Transit domain.

name: Kobe University Medtech Innovation Center, MIC (神戸大学大学院医学研究科メドテックイノベーションセンター)
operator: Kobe University Graduate School of Medicine
address: 1-5-1 Minatojima Minamimachi, Chuo-ku, Kobe 650-0047 (神戸市中央区港島南町1-5-1)
notes: Six 37 m2 rental labs, three 12 m2 offices, two shared wet-lab rooms and a shared medical device workshop, mainly for companies collaborating with Kobe University. The KBIC page calls the rental labs dry while the English brochure says all labs are wet spec, and the online application page is still under preparation.

name: HBI Shared Equipment Room (次世代医療開発センター 共用機器室)
operator: Foundation for Biomedical Research and Innovation at Kobe (神戸医療産業都市推進機構)
address: CLIK 6F, 6-3-7 Minatojima Minamimachi, Chuo-ku, Kobe 650-0047 (神戸市中央区港島南町6丁目3番地の7 クリエイティブラボ神戸6階)
notes: Pay-per-use core with a BD FACSymphony A5, BD FACSMelody sorter and ZEISS LSM 980 Airyscan, open to companies active in the cluster after approval, weekdays 9:30 to 16:30. Fees are in a linked PDF that was not read.

name: DP-Lab KOBE (ディー・ピー・ラボ神戸)
operator: Daiwa House Industry Co., Ltd. (大和ハウス工業株式会社)
address: 6-3-10 Minatojima Minamimachi, Chuo-ku, Kobe (兵庫県神戸市中央区港島南町6丁目3-10)
contact_name: Daiwa House Kobe Branch, Architecture Sales Office (神戸支社 建築営業所)
notes: New private wet-lab rental building completed 2026-08-31 with 14 units from about 98 m2 to a full floor of about 1,040 m2, BSL2/P2 capable, plus lounge and coworking space. Rent and current leasing status were not published.

name: CoLaborator Kobe / Bayer Co.Lab Kobe
operator: Bayer Yakuhin, Ltd. (バイエル薬品株式会社)
address: Inside KIBC, 5-5-2 Minatojima Minamimachi, Chuo-ku, Kobe 650-0047 (神戸市中央区港島南町5丁目5番2号 神戸国際ビジネスセンター内)
price_raw: KRP: 賃料の目安 施設までお問い合わせください; Halo: "fully subsidized lab and office space"
notes: Bayer-run shared lab (240 m2) and office (140 m2) for startups whose work connects to Bayer focus areas, with a 3-year maximum stay and document plus interview screening. The Halo call (up to 4 startups, 2-year term) showed applications closed, so check the next intake.

name: RIKEN Integrated Innovation Building, IIB (理研 融合連携イノベーション推進棟)
price_raw: "There is no cost for using the space, but labs pay their own utility bills" (2015 article)
notes: Five floors of wet and dry labs on the RIKEN Kobe campus for labs doing collaborative research with RIKEN, including outside firms and RIKEN ventures, chosen by committee. Terms come from a 2015 article and may have changed.

name: Kobe Pharmaceutical University Building A 4F Innovation Lab (神戸薬科大学Ａ棟４階イノベーションラボ)
operator: Kobe Pharmaceutical University (学校法人神戸薬科大学)
address: 4-19-1 Motoyamakitamachi, Higashinada-ku, Kobe 658-8558 (兵庫県神戸市東灘区本山北町４丁目１９−１)
price_raw: 100,000円／月（税込）※光熱水費等は別途; ラボに従事する共同研究者1名につき50,000円／月; 敷金 無し
contact_name: 学術情報課研究推進室
notes: About 60 m2 lab opened 2023 with access to shared instruments, animal and RI rooms on application, renewed yearly for up to 5 years. Only companies running a joint research contract with the university qualify, and it is in Higashinada rather than Port Island.
